name: Abaddon
desc: Places Scarab Hives that periodically spawn scarabs to seek out and attack nearby enemies and beds.
adv: Each hive spawns scarabs that hunt down enemies and beds. Scarabs attack every 0.5 seconds. Scarabs from the same hive do not stack their damage, so two scarabs from one hive deal the same DPS as one. Scarabs from different hives do stack, so two hives can hit you twice as hard, and three hives deal up to 3x the DPS. Hives are weak to pickaxes and break in 5 hits with a wooden pickaxe, 4 with stone, and 2 with iron or diamond. When a hive expires or is broken, its scarabs take about 10 damage. Scarab upgrades and Hive upgrades are bought separately.

items.name: Scarab Upgrade 1
items.desc: Scarabs deal 4 damage and have 200 HP. Scarabs can now fly and climb blocks to reach enemies.

items.name: Hive Upgrade 1
items.desc: Hive lasts 15 seconds and spawns 4 scarabs in total.

items.name: Scarab Upgrade 2
items.desc: Scarabs deal 6 damage, have 200 HP, and move faster. An exploding scarab with 100 HP spawns alongside the 4th scarab, with the same damage and block destruction as TNT.

items.name: Hive Upgrade 2
items.desc: Hive lasts 18 seconds and spawns a scarab every 3.5 seconds, 6 in total. An exploding scarab spawns with the 4th one, making 7 in total.

items.name: Scarab Upgrade 3
items.desc: Scarabs deal 8 damage and have 225 HP. Every time a scarab hits an enemy, you heal 1 HP.

items.name: Hive Upgrade 3
items.desc: Hive still lasts 18 seconds. Each spawn has a 25% chance to spawn an extra scarab. An exploding scarab still spawns with the 4th one.

abilities.name: Place Hive
abilities.desc: Places a Scarab Hive that spawns scarabs. Base (Tier 0): scarabs have 150 HP and deal 2 damage. The hive lasts 12 seconds and spawns a scarab every 4.5 seconds, 3 in total. You get a new hive every 20 seconds, holding up to 2.

passives.name: Hive Supply
passives.desc: You receive a new Scarab Hive every 20 seconds and can hold up to 2 at a time.

passives.name: Scarab Climbing
passives.desc: Scarabs can fly and climb blocks to reach enemies.

passives.name: Scarab Lifesteal
passives.desc: Every time a scarab hits an enemy, you heal 1 HP.

strategy.title: Protect your hives
strategy.text: Enemies can break hives quickly, so place them up high or hide them where they are hard to reach.

strategy.title: Let scarabs tank for you
strategy.text: Use your scarabs as a shield: they soak up hits while you fight.

name: Adetunde
desc: Start with a powerful Frosty Hammer. Hitting enemies has a chance to drop Frost Crystals, which you can spend to upgrade your hammer.
adv:
You spawn with a Frosty Hammer, which has a 4.5 block reach, the same as a sword. Every hit on an enemy has an 80% chance to give you a Frost Crystal. Crystals are spent on hammer upgrades, can be stored in your Personal Chest, and are all lost when you die.
Tier 1 costs 3 crystals (9 in total), Tier 2 costs 7 crystals (21 in total), and Tier 3 costs 15. The upgrades are Speed, Shield and Damage, and you can only pick one Tier 3 upgrade. Every time you upgrade, you are frozen in place for 2 seconds.
Shield is capped at 50. If you have not hit anyone for 2 seconds, it drops by 5 every 0.75 seconds.
The Tier 3 upgrade you pick gives you something special: Damage unlocks the Arctic Slam ability, Shield unlocks the Permafrost Shield ability, and Speed (cooldown) unlocks the Blizzard Storm passive.

items.name: Frosty Hammer
items.desc: Your main weapon, with a 4.5 block reach, the same as a sword. Tier 0 deals 23 damage every 0.35 seconds. Each hit has an 80% chance to drop a Frost Crystal.

items.name: Frost Crystal
items.desc: Gained from hitting enemies (80% chance). Spend them on hammer upgrades or store them in your Personal Chest. You lose all of them when you die.

abilities.name: Open Hammer Upgrades
abilities.desc:
Opens the hammer upgrade menu. Each upgrade freezes you in place for 2 seconds.
Tier 0: 23 damage every 0.35 seconds.
Tier 1 (3 crystals): 30 damage every 0.32 seconds, and 2 shield per attack.
Tier 2 (7 crystals): 40 damage every 0.28 seconds, and 3 shield per attack.
Tier 3 (15 crystals, pick one): 52 damage, or 4 shield per attack, or a 0.25 second cooldown. Each one unlocks its own ability or passive.

abilities.name: Permafrost Shield
abilities.desc: Gain 30 shield for 6 seconds. The shield then explodes in a 7 block radius, dealing damage based on how much shield you have. The explosion has 100% armor penetration.

abilities.name: Arctic Slam
abilities.desc: Hits 3 times over 2 seconds for 40, then 30, then 20 damage (90 in total). Each hit has 10% armor penetration. Reaches a 20 block radius, 9 blocks wide from end to end and 3 blocks tall. Damages and breaks blocks depending on their type, and launches enemies 2 blocks into the air.

passives.name: Frost Crystal Drops
passives.desc: 80% chance to gain a Frost Crystal. Crystals are lost on death, but you can keep them safe in your Personal Chest.

passives.name: Upgrade Freeze
passives.desc: You are frozen in place for 2 seconds every time you upgrade your hammer.

passives.name: Shield Decay
passives.desc: Shield is capped at 50 and drops by 5 every 0.75 seconds.

passives.name: Blizzard Storm
passives.desc: After landing 4 hits in a row, an aura with a 6 block radius forms around you. It ticks every 0.525 seconds, starting at 3 damage and rising by 1 per tick up to a max of 8. The longer you keep hitting, the longer the aura lasts after you stop: every hit adds 1 extra tick.

strategy.title: Hit and run early
strategy.text: Your hammer has a slow cooldown at first, so use hit-and-run tactics to collect crystals safely. Save them up before upgrading your cooldown, then your damage.

strategy.title: Upgrade order
strategy.text: Always keep upgrading, and take Cooldown and Damage before Shield.

strategy.title: Best Tier 3 pick
strategy.text: Tier 3 Damage gives the best DPS. You can choose the others if you prefer them or want to play that specific style.

strategy.title: Arctic Slam on bridges
strategy.text: Use Arctic Slam when enemies are crossing bridges. It destroys the bridge and drops them into the void.

name: Aery
desc: Killing enemies adds to your collection of spirit butterflies. Each spirit butterfly amplifies sword and projectile damage. Aery's base health is reduced by 10%.
adv:
Aery spawns with 90 HP. You gain 2 butterflies for every kill, and none for assists. Each butterfly is one stack, and stacks increase your projectile damage by 80% of the butterfly's value.
The bonus slows down as you collect more: each new stack adds less damage than the last, and eventually each butterfly adds less than 1 damage. After killing an enemy, you have to wait 25 seconds before you can gain stacks from that same enemy again.
When you die you lose around 30% of your stacks, a little more or less depending on how many you have.

calc.title: Stack calculator
calc.label: Butterfly stacks
calc.note: Bonus damage from butterfly stacks. The listed values are exact; other numbers use the formula damage = 2.0104 × stacks^0.7144.

passives.name: Butterfly Stacks
passives.desc: Gain 2 butterflies for every kill. Assists give none. Each butterfly is one stack.

passives.name: Butterfly Damage
passives.desc: Increases your projectile damage by 80% of the butterfly's value. Each extra stack adds less than the last, eventually under 1 damage per butterfly.

passives.name: Same-Enemy Cooldown
passives.desc: You cannot gain stacks from the same enemy again for 25 seconds.

passives.name: Stack Loss
passives.desc: You lose around 30% of your stacks, a little more or less depending on how many you have.

strategy.title: Get support early
strategy.text: Aery needs help early in the game to build up stacks. Around 20 stacks is the sweet spot.

strategy.title: Don't ego fights
strategy.text: Losing stacks hurts, so avoid fights you don't need to take.

strategy.title: Go ranged at 20 stacks
strategy.text: Once you reach 20 stacks, switch to ranged weapons so you don't risk losing all your stacks late in the game.

name: Agni
desc: Throw cluster bombs at your enemies and watch them go flying! Blast off with your Rocket Boost ability.
adv:
Agni's kit is built around fire and explosives. Fire deals 3 damage per tick for 3 ticks, 9 damage in total.
Rocket Boost launches you into the air and burns enemies it hits. Cluster Bombs are thrown at enemies and burst into smaller fire bombs that spread out and explode. Throwing a Cluster Bomb takes 2 seconds from start to finish.

items.name: Cluster Bomb
items.desc: You get a new Cluster Bomb every 35 seconds, holding up to 5, or you can buy one in the shop. The bomb deals 16-17 damage and applies Fire. It then drops 8 smaller fire bombs in a 25 block radius. Each one explodes in a 3x3 area, dealing 9 damage and applying Fire. Throwing it takes 2 seconds in total.

abilities.name: Rocket Boost
abilities.desc: Launches you up to 7 blocks into the air. Deals 12 damage to enemies and applies Fire (3 damage per tick, 3 ticks).

strategy.title: Save your iron
strategy.text: Don't waste early-game iron on Cluster Bombs. Only buy them when you have plenty of iron left over.

strategy.title: When to throw them
strategy.text: Use Cluster Bombs in group fights, and always use one when you have to fight someone one-on-one.

strategy.title: Rocket Boost tricks
strategy.text: Use Rocket Boost to save yourself from fall damage, or to deal extra damage to your enemy.

name: Alchemist
desc: Use flasks to brew various potions with foraged ingredients.
adv:
Thorns, Mushrooms and Flowers spawn frequently around the map. You can pick up all of them, and drop them or store them in a chest. The same goes for the potions you make, but not the flasks.
You can buy Alchemist Flasks in the shop for 10 iron, with a max of 16. While holding a flask, add Thorns, Mushrooms and Flowers to brew a special potion:
3 Mushrooms: Sleep Splash Potion
3 Flowers: Heal Splash Potion
1 Thorn + 2 Mushrooms: Poison Splash Potion
2 Thorns + 1 Flower: Big Shield

items.name: Alchemist Flask
items.desc: Buy up to 16 in the shop. While holding it, add Thorns, Mushrooms and Flowers to brew special potions. Flasks cannot be stored in a chest.

items.name: Mushroom
items.desc: Spawns frequently around the map. Used for Sleep and Poison potions. Can be picked up, dropped and stored in a chest.

items.name: Thorn
items.desc: Spawns frequently around the map. Used for Poison potions and Big Shields. Can be picked up, dropped and stored in a chest.

items.name: Flower
items.desc: Spawns frequently around the map. Used for Heal potions and Big Shields. Can be picked up, dropped and stored in a chest.

items.name: Sleep Splash Potion
items.desc: Stuns anyone hit, including you, for 2 seconds in a 3x3 block radius.

items.name: Heal Splash Potion
items.desc: Heals 30 HP in a 5x5 block radius.

items.name: Poison Splash Potion
items.desc: Deals 6 damage per tick for 10 ticks, with 80% armor penetration. Poison cannot kill: it leaves enemies on 1 HP at minimum.

abilities.name: Add Thorns
abilities.desc: Adds a Thorn to the flask. Used in the Poison Splash Potion (1 Thorn) and Big Shield (2 Thorns) recipes.

abilities.name: Add Mushroom
abilities.desc: Adds a Mushroom to the flask. Used in the Sleep Splash Potion (3 Mushrooms) and Poison Splash Potion (2 Mushrooms) recipes.

abilities.name: Add Flowers
abilities.desc: Adds a Flower to the flask. Used in the Heal Splash Potion (3 Flowers) and Big Shield (1 Flower) recipes.

passives.name: Foraging
passives.desc: Thorns, Mushrooms and Flowers spawn frequently around the map. You can pick up, drop and store them in a chest.

strategy.title: Craft for your playstyle
strategy.text: Choose which potions to craft depending on how you play.

strategy.title: Solo and offensive play
strategy.text: Mainly craft Heal and Sleep potions, so you can stunlock enemies and keep yourself healthy.

strategy.title: Supporting your team
strategy.text: Craft Big Shields and Heal potions for your teammates, and Sleep and Poison potions for yourself to help in fights.

strategy.title: Always be prepared
strategy.text: Use a Shield potion before every fight, and have a Poison potion ready to throw. Prioritize keeping 1 Poison potion and 1 Shield potion on hand, and always keep crafting Heal potions and Shields.

name: Arachne
desc: The Spider Queen uses web bridges to traverse the map and can summon spiderlings from her webs to attack enemies. Enemies are slowed if they run into her webs.
adv:
Arachne shoots webs that slow enemies down and double as a bridge only you and your Arachne teammates can use. Enemies who touch cobwebs are slowed by a lot, and the more cobwebs they touch, the slower they get.
You can summon spiders while you have webs placed. The number of spiders depends on your webs, up to a max of 4 (4 or more webs gives 4 spiders). Each spider spawns with 30 HP and deals 4 damage every 0.5 seconds. When a spider kills or assists on an enemy, its damage and HP go up, to a max of 80 HP and 15 damage.

abilities.name: Aim Web Bridge
abilities.desc: Shoots a web in any direction with a 17 block line radius. Enemies who touch the cobwebs are slowed by a lot, and the slow builds up the more cobwebs they touch. You can jump onto the cobwebs and use them as a bridge, but only you and other Arachne teammates can use it.

abilities.name: Spider Summon
abilities.desc: Summons spiders from your webs, up to 4 at a time (4 or more webs gives 4 spiders). Each spider spawns with 30 HP and deals 4 damage. A spider that kills or assists on an enemy gains damage and HP, up to 80 HP and 15 damage.

passives.name: Sticky Webs
passives.desc: Enemies are slowed by a lot, and the slow gets stronger the more cobwebs they touch.

passives.name: Spider Growth
passives.when: When a spider kills or assists
passives.desc: The spider's damage and HP increase, up to a max of 80 HP and 15 damage. Spiders spawn with 30 HP and 4 damage.

strategy.title: Move fast and save iron
strategy.text: Use Arachne for movement, and save a ton of iron you would normally spend on blocks.

strategy.title: Grab loot first
strategy.text: On most maps you can use the ability right away and get to the middle for loot before anyone else, depending on the mode.

strategy.title: Slow your enemies
strategy.text: The webs slow enemies down a lot, which gives you a big advantage in PvP.

strategy.title: Let spiders tank
strategy.text: Use your spiders to soak up damage while you fight.

name: Archer
desc: Can headshot with any projectile! Deal 12.5% more projectile damage and gain access to the Tactical Crossbow in the Item Shop.

name: Ares
desc: A powerful ancient warrior that uses electric-charged throwing spears to destroy his enemies.

name: Axolotl Amy
desc: Use your pet axolotls to empower yourself and nearby teammates with shields, increased attack damage, faster break speed and health regen.

name: Baker
desc: Gain access to health-gain apples, speed-boost pies, and spawn with a knockback baguette!

name: Barbarian
desc: Build rage by damaging enemies. Instead of buying swords, your sword is upgraded upon reaching max rage. You lose half your rage upon death. Emerald Sword is replaced by the Rageblade.

name: Beekeeper Beatrix
desc: Catch bees around the map to upgrade your Bee Hive. Upgrading your Bee Hive will return additional iron and emeralds.

name: Bekzat
desc: Summon a mythical falcon to dominate an area. Work in tandem to critically strike your companion's target with your feather light bows

name: Bounty Hunter
desc: Get assigned bounties for killing certain players in the match. Completing a bounty rewards a random amount of resources.

name: Builder
desc: Fortify blocks with extra health and blast protection using the Builder's hammer. Purchase the Hammer from the Item Shop.

name: Caitlyn
desc: Fulfill assassination contracts to empower your attacks with a deadly decay.

name: Cobalt
desc: Every time you take damage you have a chance of dropping a battery on the ground. Once the battery activates you can pick it up for a small shield. After collecting 3 batteries you will overload, gaining movement speed and damage!

name: Cogsworth
desc: Deploy robots that search for generators and collect resources!

name: Conqueror
desc: Place banners to empower nearby allies.

name: Crocowolf
desc: Being in the vicinity of damage dealt builds bloodlust. Activate Beast Form to temporarily give you enhanced damage, knockback, and movement speed. Dealing damage to non-player entities builds more bloodlust. When your bed breaks you will be given full bloodlust.

name: Crypt
desc: Claim souls to build your undead army! Could be unlocked for FREE by completing Crypt's Trials during the Halloween 2022 event.

abilities.name: Recall Skeletons
abilities.note: Only while holding the Necromancer Staff

abilities.name: Set Target
abilities.note: Only while holding the Necromancer Staff

abilities.name: Swap Skeleton Mode
abilities.note: Only while holding the Necromancer Staff
abilities.desc: Switch between Ranged and Fighter Skeletons.

name: Cyber
desc: Deploy and control drones to pickup resources from around the map. Drones can also airdrop primed TNT.

name: Death Adder
desc: Charge up explosive comets to rain destruction on your enemy's base. Collect alchemy crystals to unlock even stronger abilities!

name: Dino Tamer Dom
desc: Can purchase a Dino mount. Charge into defenses to knock them down!

name: Drill
desc: Purchase Drills to deploy on Diamond and Emerald generators. Drills automatically harvest 2x gen resources. Control them to fight off attackers.

name: Eldertree
desc: Collect tree orbs around the map to increase size and max HP. Cannot buy armor.

name: Eldric
desc: Drain health from enemies or sacrifice your health to heal allies. Could be unlocked for FREE by completing Crypt's Coven during the Halloween 2023 event.

name: Elektra
desc: Dash through players to deal electric damage! Hold up to two stacks of dashes and regain all stacks if you kill an enemy with your dash.

name: Ember
desc: Charge the Blade of Fire to ignite in a deadly spin! Striking enemies OR killing Lumen will upgrade your ability to a much more powerful spin.

name: Evelynn
desc: Damage enemies to attract nearby spirits. Consume spirits to instantly teleport and gain an attack buff for a short duration.

name: Farmer Cletus
desc: Invest your resources into crops that yield more diamonds and emeralds.

name: Fisherman
desc: Why fight when you can fish? Catch resources and Fish Coins, upgrade your rod, and use bait to reel in rarer rewards.

name: Flora
desc: Use explosive beehives to deal high damage to your enemies or throw them at yourself for a massive launch.

name: Fortuna
desc: Summon cards to attack players! Deal damage to enhance your cards with different effects.

name: Freiya
desc: Dealing damage will apply stacks of Frost. At four stacks, Frost is consumed and applies Frostbite to the target, making them fragile. Emerald Sword is replaced by the Ice Sword, which applies two stacks per hit. Use your Frost Explosion ability to immediately deal damage to nearby targets with stacks of Frost.

name: Frosty
desc: Passively create Frosted Snowballs for free. Frosted Snowballs are faster and larger.

name: Gingerbread Man
desc: Place gumdrops bounce pads for extreme movement. Using a gumdrop bounce pad negates all fall damage and grants a shield.

name: Gompy
desc: Gompy the Ghost Hunter! Find ghosts around the map, vacuum them and fire them across the map.

name: Gregory
desc: Place gargoyle statues and take control of them.

name: Grim Reaper
desc: Consuming enemy souls grants health regen, movespeed and invulnerability for 2.5s. Combat is disabled while consuming.

name: Grove
desc: Purchase seeds and grow them into flowers that buff allies and enhance generator production. Keep your flowers alive by providing them with spirit energy gathered around the map to prevent them from withering.

name: Hannah
desc: Activate your Execute ability to defeat a nearby enemy with low health! Hannah's base health is reduced by 10%.

name: Hephaestus
desc: Upgrade your Talos Mech to increase shield and damage! Activate Self-Destruct to deal massive damage.

abilities.name: Summon Talos Mech
abilities.note: Only when out of the mech

name: Ignis
desc: Use a spirit bridge to travel around the map healing your allies and providing them with armor buffs.

name: Infernal Shielder
desc: Spawn with a massive shield. Gain energy while holding your shield, and raise your shield to deflect incoming projectiles.

abilities.name: Leap
abilities.note: Only while holding the Infernal Shield

name: Isabel
desc: Upgrade her shield by purchasing better swords. Each upgraded shield will block more damage before breaking. The final upgrade, the Emerald Shield, will block all damage from the first hit. Shields reactivate after 30 [sic] seconds.

name: Jack
desc: Lob bundles of poisonous pumpkin oil across the map.

name: Jade
desc: Launch into the air with a giant war hammer. Higher launches deal more slam damage, and the hammer can be upgraded throughout the match.

name: Kaida
desc: Summon a powerful dragon's claw to swipe multiple enemies at once, or summon a dragon head through a rune below you to damage all surrounding enemies. Upgrade your claw and summon attack by damaging enemies with your summon spell.

name: Kaliyah
desc: A fearsome warrior with a fiery punch!

name: Krystal
desc: Keep moving (especially on frozen blocks!) to increase your momentum and movement speed. At high momentum, trigger jumps to dodge.

name: Lani
desc: An ascended healer, Lani can purchase the Scepter of Light. Use this Scepter to fly to your low health allies, providing healing and damage reduction!

name: Lassy
desc: Wrangle enemies towards you using a lasso.

name: Lian
desc: A mysterious warrior gifted by the dragon. Control swords to fight your enemy

name: Lucía
desc: Use the candy you get from damaging players to fill up your piñata. When you're ready, smash it for lots of loot!

name: Lumen
desc: Charge the Sword of Light to shoot powerful waves at enemies! Hitting light waves OR killing Ember will upgrade your ability to shoot many powerful beams at once.

name: Lyla
desc: Your bow is replaced with the Floral Bow! Shooting an enemy twice will bloom a flower on their head, attracting a swarm of bees!

name: Marcel
desc: Use your Defense Scanner to instantly purchase blocks in the Defense Schematic shown around your team's bed. Can place two Tesla Traps.

name: Marina
desc: Deploy jellyfish and electrify them with your Electric Pulse ability, causing them to zap nearby enemies. Connect jellyfish to increase the range and power of your ability.

name: Marrow
desc: Defy death and hop around as a skull after taking mortal damage. Survive long enough in this form and you will revive! Use your ability to create poison clouds that damage and slow enemies (this ability also triggers while in skull form).

name: Martin
desc: Absorb life essence from nearby enemies and convert it to max hp! Attack is slower but passively reflects damage for melee hits to the enemy.

name: Melody
desc: Use a guitar and the power of music to heal nearby teammates. Heal yourself for 50% [sic] of the heal given.

name: Merchant Marco
desc: Get resources back on certain item shop purchases! This refund is randomized each game!

name: Metal Detector
desc: Use a Metal Detector to find treasure around the map.

name: Milo
desc: Disguise as a block and pickpocket from other players!

name: Miner
desc: Killing enemies turns them into stone. The Miner can break down the stone for valuables[sic]'’ resources (scaled by the price of enemy's armor + sword). Unable to purchase Axes.

name: Nahla
desc: Use water veil to temporally boost the health regen of nearby allies. Purchase upgrades for your oasis vessel to strengthen your healing and buffing abilities!

name: Nazar
desc: Give up out-of-combat health regeneration to manipulate your life force and empower your attacks or heal. Gain life force by landing shots with life arrows and attacking.

name: Noelle
desc: Tame slimes to befriend your team, providing your teammates with unique buffs that strengthen over time!

name: Nyoka
desc: Charge your Mending Canopy to shine healing light on your allies.

name: Nyx
desc: Trigger the darkness of Midnight to deal ramping increased damage and armor pen.

name: Pirate Davey
desc: Use a TNT Cannon to bombard your enemies.

name: Pyro
desc: Use your flamethrower to spray fire, making enemies brittle, and taking more damage from attacks. Killing brittle enemies rewards ember, which you can use to upgrade your flamethrower.

name: Ragnar
desc: Use your Berserker Rage ability to increase break speed, reduce incoming damage and prevent incoming knockback to rush in on an enemy's bed defense.

name: Ramil
desc: Create sandstorms to control the battlefield, move enemies, and protect allies.

name: Raven
desc: Buy ravens and fly at enemies to deliver deadly doses of poison.

name: Santa
desc: Play as Santa and call in high-explosive sleigh strafe runs!

name: Sheep Herder
desc: Find and tame wild sheep around the map. Each tamed sheep amplifies your damage.

name: Sheila
desc: Start the game with an egg on your shoulder. Get kills to hatch and evolve your Seahorse, increasing its damage and unlocking passive abilities.

name: Sigrid
desc: Summon your mount, charge at your enemies and send them flying! Cannot use weapons while riding the Elk.

name: Silas
desc: The leader of the citizens' rebellion, who encourages and buffs his allies with healing and damage auras!

name: Skoll
desc: Summon your void wolf companion Fenrir to mark an enemy. Deal extra damage to your marked target, gain a speed boost when following their trail, and see them through walls. You can detonate the mark to end the effect and deal damage.

abilities.name: Hunt's End
abilities.note: Only while Fenrir is on a target

name: Smoke
desc: A stealth-focused kit that uses smoke charges to grant invisibility.

name: Sophia
desc: Use a Frost Staff to slow and freeze enemies!

name: Spirit Catcher
desc: Carry a jar of regenerating spirits. Catch wisps from damaged enemies to recharge faster, and recall unused spirits. Place idle spirits together to fuse them into a larger spirit with a chain of shrinking explosions.

abilities.name: Recall Spirits
abilities.note: Only when a spirit is placed

name: Star Collector Stella
desc: Pick up floating stars around the map. Consume them while near teammates to share permanent Max Health and Critical Strike chance!

name: Styx
desc: Connect your Confluence Portal to a slain enemy to teleport you and your allies to that location.

name: Taliyah
desc: Buy eggs & hatch them into chickens! Chickens can either be sold back to the merchant or deployed in combat!

name: Terra
desc: Stomp the ground to gather protective blocks, then kick them at your enemies. Each successful hit permanently increases kick damage!

name: Trapper
desc: Place Snap Traps to stun unexpecting enemies, Damaging a recently trapped enemy will consume a mark dealing extra damage.

name: Trinity
desc: Ascend into an angelic form and switch freely between Light and Void. When you melee attack, Light form grants shield for you and allies, and Void form inflicts max health decay on your target.

name: Triton
desc: An agile warrior with a Trident! Hurl your trident towards a wall, or your opponents, to quickly travel and dominate the battlefield.

name: Trixie
desc: Warp around and confuse your enemies with evasive combat. Every time you use Rift Warp you gain a buff that allows you to reduce Rift Warp's cooldown with melee attacks. You can also use Rift Rewind to teleport back to your last warp point.

name: Uma
desc: Summon creatures from the spirit world to assist you in combat, healing, and resource collecting!

name: Umbra
desc: Toss a hat onto other players to gain the ability to teleport to them from anywhere on the map. Ally players near the target destination are given boosted movement speed and several seconds of invulnerability while enemy players are knocked back and briefly slowed.

name: Umeko
desc: Use chakrams to fight at mid-range. You can turn invisible and escape from battle if you get attacked by a melee attack.

name: Vanessa
desc: Super charge your bow to perform a triple shot.

name: Void Knight
desc: Feed your Void Corruption with resources and kills to upgrade your gear and unlock your abilities of Void Decay and Shielding. With enough resources, unlock the full power of the Void and become the Ascended Void Knight. Void Knight's base health is reduced by 10%.

name: Void Regent
desc: Use a Void Axe to dash forward while slashing at enemies, healing for a portion of the damage dealt.

name: Vulcan
desc: Use a high tech tablet to control camera turrets across the map. While holding the tablet, mark enemies or link to your turrets' view.

name: Warden
desc: Imprison the souls of recently killed enemies to increase their respawn time. For each actively imprisoned soul you gain Break Speed and Shield Regeneration.

name: Warrior
desc: Gain grit in battle and can keep fighting after taken fatal damage.

name: Whim
desc: Master arcane secrets to unlock elemental powers! Spawn with a magic spellbook. Deal 20% reduced damage with swords and take 10% increased damage from all sources.

name: Whisper
desc: Control a Spirit Owl to support ally players. Unlocked at Player Level 10.

abilities.name: Heal + Speed
abilities.note: Only while using the owl on another player

abilities.name: Deactivate
abilities.note: Only while using the owl on another player

abilities.name: Fly
abilities.note: Only while using the owl on another player

name: Wren
desc: Summon a secret black market offering powerful potions and random deals. Earn a cut from every sale, and use shadow coins gathered from fallen players to upgrade your shop.

name: Xu'rot
desc: Transform into Dragon Form, unlocking a decaying dragon breath and the ability to fly. Items can't be used while in dragon form and damage scales with the highest tier sword obtained.

name: Yamini
desc: Climb and pounce with feline dexterity! Fall damage is reduced since you always land on your feet.

name: Yeti
desc: Let out a Glacier Roar to temporarily freeze nearby blocks. Frozen blocks can be destroyed extremely fast.

name: Yuzi
desc: Swords are replaced by traditional Dao Swords. Hold attack to execute a forward dash AOE attack.

name: Zarrah
desc: Wields a Cutlass and Blunderbuss. Ability fires the Blunderbuss, damaging and marking enemies ahead while knocking you back. Melee hits on marked foes reset cooldown, cause bleeding, and grant a speed boost.

name: Zenith
desc: Deploy a satellite to disrupt enemy team economies. Enemy shop prices are increased and you get a cut of each purchase!

name: Zeno
desc: Use a magical staff to cast lightning spells.

abilities.name: Ability Swap
abilities.desc: Switch between Normal Lightning and Lightning Storm.

name: Zephyr
desc: Killing enemies gives you a stack of wind, decaying a short while after. Each stack of wind gives you more speed and adds a second wind strike to your attack. At 5 stacks you can triple jump!

name: Zola
desc: Connect enemies with soul links! Damage dealt to linked enemies incurs bonus damage to any other linked enemies. Allies can also be linked, allowing you to take damage in their place.
